messages:
Priya Shah: Heads up — CloudStripe flagged billing for Apr month. Looks like our Q2 pricing experiment applied reseller discounts incorrectly; they were double-discounted (reseller + promo). Can finance review? Invoice 2024-04-CS-7890 shows unexpected negative line items. :grimacing:
Sam Torres: Ugh. Can you paste the invoice link and total overcharged amount?
Priya Shah: https://billing.redwood.com/invoices/2024-04-CS-7890 total charged = $45,620 but expected $37,000 => overcharged ~$8,620. They have a reserved commit for dedicated capacity.
Maya Chen: Adding context — reseller tier discount 15% should have applied instead of stack with promo 10%. Looks like promo applied before reseller discount, stacking incorrectly. I'll pull the usage + pricing calc.
Leo Patel: @Maya can you confirm if this is systemic or one-off? If systemic we might need a retro adjustment for multiple invoices.
Maya Chen: Quick check: only Apr invoice so far. Looks like promo flag toggled in the pricing experiment rollout script on 2024-04-01 and the reseller rule was not scoped. Single merchant impacted (CloudStripe reseller account id RS-443).
Sam Torres: Ok — proposed remedy: issue manual prorated credit for $8,620 + goodwill $1,000 for disruption. Total credit $9,620. Need approvals.
Priya Shah: @Leo +1 on the goodwill given they lost revenue from delayed refunds. Legal ok?
Amy (Legal): fine with $1k goodwill. Confirm there's no ongoing contract clause preventing credits. We reviewed RS-443 terms.
Leo Patel: Approve provisional credit $9,620. Finance to process and mark as 'pending approval' in NetSuite.
Sam Torres: I'll open a ticket and create a Journal Entry. GL code: 6900 (Customer Credits). Please confirm memo.
Maya Chen: Memo: 'CloudStripe RS-443 - Prorated pricing experiment double-discount correction (Apr 2024)'
Sam Torres: Created ticket #BILL-4721. Invoice 2024-04-CS-7890 linked. ETA credit applied: EOD tomorrow. :clock1:
billing-bot: Credit transaction created: CR-202404-4721 amount=9620 status=pending (initiated by Sam)
Priya Shah: Thanks — I'll notify CloudStripe and CC AM. Please include advice on steps to avoid recurrence.
Sam Torres: Will add root-cause and steps in the ticket: fix experiment scoping, run a find/replace reprice for Apr, and add a guard in deploy pipeline.
Leo Patel: Thx. Sam, once posted, please paste the ledger entry here so I can sign off.
Sam Torres: Will do. FYI command I ran:
```
ns-post-credit --invoice 2024-04-CS-7890 --amount 9620 --memo "CloudStripe RS-443 - Prorated pricing experiment correction"
```
Sam Torres: Posted. Ledger id: JE-89021. Credit status: posted. Last check: refund flag false (we issued account credit per contract) :white_check_mark:
billing-bot: Invoice 2024-04-CS-7890 updated: balance reduced by 9620. Journal: JE-89021. Ticket BILL-4721 updated.
Priya Shah: Sending customer note now. Closing loop once AM confirms receipt.
Maya Chen: Also added a small script change in pricing-experiments to prevent cross-scope flagging: PR#3537
Leo Patel: Good work team. Closing from finance side once AM confirms.
Priya Shah: :thumbsup:
